notes: Use this divider to pivot from water as a constraint to productivity as the income translation issue. Stress that Gujarat is not uniformly underperforming: the problem is uneven yield strength across crops that matter to different districts. Expect the question: are the next gains agronomy-led, crop-mix-led, or market-led?
title: Gujarat’s productivity is world-class in some commercial crops but remains uneven in broad-acre crops that still anchor many districts
subtitle: This section tests whether Gujarat’s strong commercial farm base converts into consistent on-farm output, separating crop-specific productivity leadership from the staple and fodder gaps that still limit district-level income growth.
